items.title: Why Are Lennar (LEN) Shares Soaring Today

items.title: Warren Buffett's Farewell: What Investors Can Learn From His Biggest Mistake
Lennar Stock Is Depressed. Why Berkshire Hathaway Is Piling In.
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway  purchased more than $200 million of depressed  Lennar  stock over three trading days and now owns just over 10% of the country’s second largest home builder.  Berkshire bought about 2.6 million shares of Lennar’s Class A shares on Thursday, Friday, and Monday.  The company also owns over 500,000 shares of Lennar’s supervoting Class B stock.

items.title: Berkshire Now Owns About 10% of Lennar
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway is doubling down on the U.S. housing market. The conglomerate bought roughly $212.4 million worth of home-builder Lennar's shares in recent days, according to securities filings. The purchases mean that Berkshire now owns around 10% of Lennar.
